gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall favourable prior year development of GBP 18.6 million, primarily driven by improvements in casualty reinsurance (GBP 18.8 million) and marine reinsurance (GBP 1.1 million). This was partially offset by adverse development in property reinsurance (GBP 1.3 million). The 2021 year of account, which is part of the prior years, closed with a profit despite being affected by events such as the war in Ukraine, Winter Storm Uri, Hurricane Ida, and late 2021 tornadoes and wildfires.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall improvement of GBP 18.6 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year.

Due to the timing of the awful events of early 2022 in Ukraine, the majority of the syndicate's allocated reserves for this loss are sitting within the 2021 year of account.
The year of account was also affected by some extreme natural peril losses.
An unusual winter storm, named Uri, hit Texas in February 2021 with snow and a severe freeze that caused around $15 billion of damage.

In August 2021 Hurricane Ida, the second most powerful storm to hit Louisiana after Hurricane Katrina in 2005, doused 25 parishes of the state with water and damaging winds and caused an estimated loss of around $40 billion.
The year finished with an unusual run of very late tornados in the US mid-west and a wildfire in Denver in late December 2021.
